proves.claim: offerLandingJob keeps each landed item's pace (sprint, steady or strict) in the job payload, gives an item with no pace steady, and refuses any other pace as LANDING_ITEMS.

api.landing-pace.items-carry-pace.why: Without it a pace chosen on the cli side never reaches the runner's landing job, so every landed item reads as steady.

proves.claim: offerLandingJob given a sprint plan { static, testCommand, testFiles } puts payload.sprint on a job with a sprint item, leaves it off with no plan or only steady and strict items, and refuses a malformed plan as LANDING_SPRINT.

api.landing-pace.sprint-plan-rides-the-p.why: Without it the sprint plan the cli builds is dropped at the offer, so the runner never proves a sprint item's merged tree.
